correctness.rationale: Projection reduces by an invertible affine map to the convex hull of two disks. A direct four-piece Green area integral gives the exact area profile; the support function of the projected hull gives the perimeter profile by Cauchy integration. Explicit quadratic expansion at first contact gives positive 3/2 perimeter coefficient, while the two-disk area expansion gives the independent 3/2 area coefficient. Haar normal distribution and positive algebraic inverses are exact. The packaged standard-library independent convex-hull checker passes 156 finite assertions; these are corroborative only, not a substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The paired first-contact singularities quantify the change in a natural two-dimensional silhouette observable; their nonanalytic exponents distinguish true rim emergence from smooth shape change. The exact local inverse uses one baseline perimeter, a contact angle, and one curvature-like singularity coefficient to recover three nondegenerate geometric dimensions. The invariant is intrinsic to the complete natural three-parameter frustum family and relevant to orthographic shape inference, not an arbitrary finite slice.
